name: Animals Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that God created animals as living souls and sustains them by His providence, as seen in Genesis where every beast and creature is made according to its kind and given life (Genesis 1:25, 1:30). Job affirms that the soul of every living thing is in God's hand, highlighting His sovereign care over all creatures (Job 12:10). The Psalms and Proverbs emphasize God's preservation of both man and beast and commend the righteous for valuing the life of their animals (Psalms 36:6; Proverbs 12:10). While Scripture does not explicitly teach animals go to heaven, it underscores God’s ongoing care and the intrinsic value He places on all living creatures.
